description: This Java source file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class, which implements the LogNode interface to filter log messages, passing only the message content downstream in a logging chain.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A LogNode implementation that filters logs to pass only message contents, ignoring metadata or tags.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the message filter with an optional next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Overrides the LogNode interface method to pass only the message content to the next node, ignoring priority, tag, and Throwable.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
